Title: Public Preview: Standard Load Balancer (SLB) Health Probe Redesign in AKS

Body.Content:
AKS now offers improved load balancing for services using externalTrafficPolicy: Cluster. This enhancement enables the standard load balancer (SLB) to probe kube-proxy directly instead of backend applications. This new capability enhances reliability, reduces misconfigurations, and improves traffic routing.  


Learn more.
